summary.text: Jessica Bahmuller is a Republican state representative from District 19 who took office in January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She works as a municipal finance officer.

paragraphs.text: Jessica Bahmuller's career experience includes working as a municipal finance officer, according to Ballotpedia.
She assumed office in the South Dakota House of Representatives on January 10, 2023.
In the 2025-2026 session, Bahmuller is vice chair of the House Commerce and Energy Committee and serves on the House State Affairs Committee.

Ballotpedia also lists her as having sought the Republican nomination for the South Dakota Public Utilities Commission in 2026, though she did not appear on the ballot at the party's June 27, 2026 convention.
